messages:
nora: Heads-up: product approved the model-name remapping and a soft deprecation for the old /models API. We need a short public deprecation note + internal migration guide.

ben: ok. timeline? customers want at least 6 weeks notice.

nora: publish notice tomorrow as "soft deprecation" with 8-week sunset, then 4-week hard deprecation email. I'll draft language but need the canonical mapping table and SDK snippets.

zoe: I can produce the mapping. Current plan: redwood-small -> rw-sm-1, redwood-medium -> rw-md-1, redwood-large -> rw-lg-1, redwood-instruct -> rw-instruct-1. Will call out differences for quantized variants and tokens.

pat: docs action items: 1) deprecation note in /docs/announcements, 2) migration guide page with mapping table + quickcode examples for JS/TS/Py, 3) sed/grok one-liners to help customers bulk-replace model names.

ben: also add a stub for 'what to expect' (tokenization drift, small prompt tune may be required). Add troubleshooting tips: 404 model not found, permission errors for pinned models.

nora: for SDKs, note the param rename: old clients accepted `model` string; v2 clients use `model_id` and recommend pinning (e.g., rw-md-1@2025-01). Add snippet showing both v1->v2.

zoe: I'll make a short CSV mapping and paste into the PR. Also include a tiny Python script to rewrite simple config files (not a replacement for code mods, but helpful).

pat: reviewers: @ben for copy, @zoe for mapping accuracy, and eng-ml for verification. I'll create the PR with a checklist and link to the internal deprecation playbook.

docs-bot: Preview queued: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/model-remap-deprecation (will post when ready).

ben: quick note on messaging: call it "model name remapping" not "rename" to avoid implying model changes. Keep tone operational and include contact link for enterprise accounts.

nora: good point. I'll draft now and tag reviewers. PR ETA: 2 hours.

zoe: ping me once PR is up; I'll run a quick grep across examples to ensure no stray legacy names remain.

pat: thank you all — will coordinate the publish schedule with comms after docs are live.
